title: Molecularly engineered membrane-driven interphase stabilization of electrodes for Li||NCM811 cells under practical operating conditions
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04968G, Paper
Dong-Yeob Han, Jiyoon Lee, Youmin Bang, Sangwon Lee, Hyeongseok Shim, Yubhin Cho, Gyujin Song, Tae Kyung Lee, Soojin Park
